remarks: Large 2BR/2Bth end unit in Putnam Park located in the heart of downtown Greenwich. Designer touches throughout with fully renovated primary bath, refinished hardwood floors, formal dining room with built-ins. Set in rear of complex with 3 exposures providing lots of sunlight and quiet relaxation. The pulldown attic allows for ample storage. All NEW WINDOWS to be installed. This lovely unit affords all the convenience of an in-town location closely located to Metro North train, Greenwich Avenue, Whole Foods, award winning restaurants and world class shopping. Monthly maintenance includes heat, hot water, trash, snow removal, and landscaping. Additional shared storage space is available for residents. Garage $85 per month when available. District tax $1,062 semi-annually (2x a year).
